Open-Air Bar &
Restaurant in Mission Beach
body: Miss B's Coconut Club is an open-air Mission Beach restaurant and bar built for long afternoons, tropical cocktails, daily brunch, and relaxed meals steps from the Pacific.
Find us at 3704 Mission Blvd for Caribbean-inspired food, a full cocktail program, happy hour, brunch, and group gatherings in the tropical dining room and outdoor patio.
